notes.title: Light and Embers release date.
notes.notes:
I decided to hit the release button for Light and Embers on May 27th, 2020 at Noon EDT. 
Tomorrow you will be able to relax and enjoy a stress-free campfire :) 

Thanks to everyone that added the game to their wishlist and visited the page.  

I hope you enjoy the game,
Roger || PROJECTaroid
